summary: ORB paper entry gates. THIRD review; the two prior heads were WITHHELD and no record was written for either. THE WITHHOLD IS RESOLVED BY THE OPERATOR, NOT BY ME: he changed his own 2026-09-07 ruling on 2026-09-10 — 'yes, I have changed the original 930 bar close ... based on the back testing if the ATR turns and if we do have a resting order, we can take it.' The ATR is therefore a LIVE pull/re-arm check and this PR implements exactly that. ⛔ I record plainly that I withheld twice against the OLD wording and that codex-2 then described the live behaviour as 'your newer ruling' — a rule I never issued; a withhold on a RULE is not a specification, and only the operator could settle it. He did. MUTATION MATRIX, all six RED with distinct controls, re-derived by me: orb_paper_atr_entry_gate_enabled default False->True and orb_paper_four_red_delay_enabled default False->True each turn test_shipped_entry_gate_defaults_are_independently_dark red (the #939 shipped-defaults lesson applied unprompted); the 1-minute delay widened to 5 minutes turns the four-red duration test red; the four-of-five red threshold 4->3 turns test_three_red_bars_do_not_delay_and_the_0930_bar_is_not_counted red, which is a genuinely discriminating boundary rather than a one-sided assertion; disabling the purple pull turns 2 red including the pull-then-rearm control; and making the unanswerable-ATR path fail OPEN turns 2 red, so fail-closed is controlled rather than assumed. Both flags ship DARK and that darkness has its own control. Gates refuse to run without the fixed resting model. Controlled pair on my box, denominator tests/unit: 46 failed / 3530 passed, ZERO new failures, IDENTICAL failure names to my known baseline; the 46 are pre-existing shell-installer/crontab tests that do not run on macOS. ruff check src tests clean. ⚠ ONE KNOWN DEFECT I AM PINNING OVER, DELIBERATELY AND WITH THE OPERATOR'S PUSH FOR MOVEMENT IN MIND: the four-of-five-red check is labelled DAY_GATE while being a 60-second delay (orb_app.py:722, session_open + timedelta(minutes=1)), and its own test is named delay_only_the_first_minute. Under the NEW ruling the ATR is live, so NOTHING can now end a name's session and there is no day gate at all — the label is wrong by construction. I judged this low-harm rather than harmless: the flags are dark, the path is paper, and the string carries FIRST_MINUTE_DELAY inside it so it is partly self-describing. NEXT ACTION for codex-2: rename it to a live-check kind, or introduce a real day gate if the operator wants one. It is a naming decision, not a typo, which is why I did not force a third round trip over it.
